Subject: Pilot readiness & procurement next steps — Meridian Health MAP and SOW review

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have shared dates, owners, and success criteria. Please confirm or flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you described
- Latency spikes on conversational triage workflows when concurrency increases (esp. evenings).
- Token cost is a concern for long patient histories in responses.
- Need for auditability and retention controls for clinical QA.

Top goals for the 6-week pilot
1) Reduce tail latency (95th pct) from ~1.8s to <=1.2s for 512-token prompts.
2) Demonstrate 30% token-cost reduction via KV caching + batching for repeat-question patterns.
3) Deliver basic audit log export (S3) and a small set of redaction hooks for PHI review.

Proposed MAP (owners & milestone dates)
- Week 0 (by 2028-07-08): Sign SOW and finalize basic security attachments — Owner: Meridian (Tim / Priya) + Redwood (Marissa).
- Week 1 (by 2028-07-15): Private environment onboarding + VPN/VPC peering test — Owner: Redwood infra (Aditya) + Meridian infra (Priya).
- Week 2–4 (by 2028-08-05): Pilot run (traffic ramp to 50% of target concurrency) — Owner: Meridian product + Redwood ops.
- Week 5–6 (by 2028-08-19): Evaluation window + metrics review and decision meeting — Owner: Meridian stakeholders + Redwood AE.

Success criteria (pass/fail):
- 95th percentile latency <=1.2s for >=80% of test scenarios.
- Token cost per session reduced by >=20% vs baseline (measured on identical prompts).
- Audit exports available to the Meridian test bucket every 24 hours.

Attachments: I attached the working SOW draft and the security questionnaire responses you requested.
- meridian-pilot-sow-draft.pdf (SOW + payment terms, Appendix A: data flows)
- security-answers-2028-06.xlsx (SOC2, retention, encryption notes)

Asks / next steps
1) Could you confirm the decision owner(s) and whether the finance team needs a PO vs invoice model?
2) Please introduce procurement (Tim) on this thread so we can align on timing for signatures and PO issuance.
3) If these milestone dates look tight, tell us which checkpoints we should push; we can compress the technical onboarding if procurement is fast.

I’ll update the SOW with the milestone dates above and move it to DocuSign once Tim confirms the procurement path.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
